name: Web UI Tokens
note: Defaults for projects with no existing token system. Project tokens always take precedence: Farga ships its own spacing (--px-*), type (--fs-*), button and --control-h values in scss/, so use those rather than these numbers.

spacingScale.note: 4px-grid steps. Farga's --px-* is a 1.5x progression instead; use whichever the project has, never both.

fontFamilies.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
fontFamilies.note: Check the fallback as carefully as the first family: a font that is missing on the user's platform silently drops the intended voice.

buttons.note: Tiers matching Farga's classes. minHeight is the pointer target floor, not the visual height: the derived height comes from font size plus vertical padding. To reach 44px, grow the hit area rather than distorting the padding ratio.

elevation.note: One overhead light source: raised surfaces cast down, recessed wells are lit on the bottom inner edge with an inset shadow. Farga has no scale yet (dialog, drawer and popover each carry a different shadow).

touchTargets.note: AA passes on size alone at 24x24, or on spacing: a 24px-diameter circle centred on the target must not intersect another target's circle, which works out to 4px of clear space around a 16px control.
